set.pl: Kelly's Bluff reservoir site, S of W. Third St, Dubuque (1914-15 construction; Out Lot 732); Kelly's property per the WPA guide was at the S end of Cardiff St nearby
pinev: WPA Iowa guide (1938): directly behind St Raphael's Cathedral, S end of Cardiff St, at the bluff edge (GNIS Kellys Bluff 42.4958,-90.6687).
1914 reservoir site = Out Lot 732 on Kelly's Bluff (Water Department report); boundaries not yet located.

A round structure about 40 m across at 42.4944,-90.6726 (1930 Iowa ortho, 2020 lidar). The 1909 and 1950 Sanborns show no reservoir there, but 1914 engineering journals place the new reservoir 'on Kelly's bluff, south of West Third St.' ($66,000 contract, built 1914-15) = this round structure; Out Lot 732 is not mapped but the site is fixed. Treasure rates the placement B-plus.

src: Engineering journals 1914 (Engineering News / Engineering Record, HathiTrust): new Dubuque reservoir 'on Kelly's bluff, south of West Third St.' (volume/page to follow)
